title: Keema's Pumpkin Farm
address: 6532 Point Pleasant Rd, Elk Grove, CA 95757
blurb: Family pumpkin farm in Elk Grove: u-pick pumpkins, corn maze, farm animals, playground and jumping pillow. Tue–Fri 11am–6pm, Sat–Sun 10am–6pm (Oct 31–Nov 1: 10am–4pm); closed Mondays. Cash only: adults 13+ $8, kids 2–12 $6, under 2 free.

title: Second Tuesday Crafternoon at A Seat at the Table Books
venue: A Seat at the Table Books
blurb: Monthly kids' crafternoon at Elk Grove's family-run bookshop and cafe. Free.
